Design artifacts without requirement grounding lack constitutional authority; code lacking a design owner evidences drift; untraceable shipping code/tests are ungoverned Product surface. Tests validating implementation habit lock in drift. Persistent observation/projection delta requires intake diagnosis but alone identifies neither the wrong relation nor observation sufficiency. constraints.statement: Transitional paths, migration scaffolds and fallbacks have no permanent live authority. Retire them when superseded; retained responsibility must satisfy the Core Interface Migration Rule retention relation. conditions: The fundamental-migration applicability condition holds.

grounding.quote:
1. Declare the migration line and treat the prior line as source material.
2. Establish fresh constitutional surfaces for method, goals, intent, product, requirements, and design.
3. Move the prior implementation sideways if needed so it cannot continue as ambient live authority.
4. Classify inherited constitutional material as adopted, superseded, deferred, or orphaned.
5. Classify inherited implementation material as `carry_across`, `redundant`, or `rewrite`.
6. Copy forward only what is intentionally retained.
7. Re-derive downstream design and code from the new constitutional surfaces, not from ambient precedent.

constraints.statement: Nothing carries forward automatically: every retained statement, requirement, design choice and guide rule requires explicit re-adoption. Intentional carry-forward should enter its correct goals/intent/product/requirements/design/guide/template layer. Old design/code governs only if explicitly re-derived and re-adopted. Before reuse classify every inherited module, interface, carrier, projection and proof surface; unclassified inherited implementation is a defect. Declare the migration line; establish fresh method/goals/intent/product/requirements/design; move old implementation sideways if needed to remove ambient authority; classify constitutional material as adopted/superseded/deferred/orphaned and implementation as carry_across/redundant/rewrite; copy only intentional retentions; derive new downstream design/code. carry_across still requires explicit re-adoption. Direct runtime/projection/prompt/proof/review reliance on the sideways line is bridge debt; partial target proxies still relying on it are not lawful closure. Creating the new surface is lawful supersession, not silent mutation of the old.

exceptions: Explicitly specified, deterministically routed, non-overlapping Product or compatibility scopes may coexist while the enclosing migration remains visibly open.

grounding.quote:
Explicitly specified, deterministically routed, non-overlapping Product or
compatibility scopes are not competing authority under this rule. They may
coexist while the enclosing migration remains visibly open.

If compatibility is retained, it must be:

- named as current product behavior
- justified in the specification
- bounded in scope
- tested as an intentional feature

Otherwise the correct action is deletion, not passive preservation.

constraints.statement: In flight, mixed implementation may exist only below the current break boundary as explicitly non-authoritative plumbing; adapters/scaffolds must be named, bounded and outside acceptance. Prior-model traces must never create competing or ambiguous dual authority over the same request, fact, identity, state or projection. Once landed over the declared scope, only the new operative surface remains live, prior paths are erased, and migration history survives only in version control, event history and superseded records. Mixed models are not a stable end state. Retained compatibility must be named current Product behavior, specification-justified, scope-bounded and tested; otherwise delete it.

Product is not release notes and must communicate material intended use, release/install, live-use, observability and retirement/supersession posture. Copy its exact template with the prescribed definition filename. Assign stable product.definition_id for the mutable WHAT line, source-project locator and bounded context, distinct from every immutable Product/release identity. Bind source, non-operative selector, exact basis URI/digest, every additional authority and relevant basis-qualified entrypoint; confirm collective axioms/ontology/epistemology/taxonomy/semantics sufficiency. Bind bootstrap and portable targets relative to resolved product.source_project; preflight every target and install/refresh only marker-bounded discovery blocks. Bind or explicitly empty axiom/override/disambiguation collections. Bind at least one accepted collective reference-frame basis, admitting authorities and exact scope. Confirm Goals, derive goals→intent→product and bind entrypoints. Gather/derive/classify/bind live requirement surfaces without a co-equal rival. Bind at least one build tenant with root/design/implementation and any shared realization law. Bind Goals, ticket lanes, comments and optional sprint root. Explicitly bind every known composition edge with target definition identity, relation authority and non-empty contracts. Validate JSON/URI syntax; synchronize/verify installed basis; resolve every URI and check cross-definition identity, composition, constitutional sufficiency and authority congruence.
constraints.uncertainty: Referenced schemas, installation protocol and check definitions are not supplied.

exceptions: An explicitly bound and verified project-local exact copy is lawful but not the default.

grounding.quote:
When editing or repricing methodology, the mutable source path is authoring
authority for the candidate being constructed. It is not operative consumer
law before release and explicit selection.

constraints.statement: Mutable methodology authoring under specification_methodology/specification/standards/ governs only a future candidate. Operative consumer authority is the exact selected immutable release, distributed by default in the manager's shared versioned store matching basis URI and digest, until explicit adoption of another cut. Project constitution resides at what bindings; realization/work at how/ticketing. Do not create a competing local methodology root such as specification/standards/ or bind mutable/partial method source as the release. Selection never follows file proximity. Once the bound requirement set is live, no rival monolithic requirement document should remain co-equal; folder choice is not prescribed.

conditions: Substantive intake arrives; feature-specific duties apply when a feature is introduced or changed.
exceptions: Goals, Intent and Product update only when their respective stated conditions change.
Scenarios are required for capability claims requiring operational proof; other evidence is defined for non-capability requirements where appropriate.
Declarative expression is preferred, not an absolute ban on imperative mechanisms.

grounding.quote:
When `DESIGN_MODULE_METHOD.md` applies, use its decision-completeness rule:
   design, implementation, and tests may co-evolve only when
   `co_evolution_admissible(B)` holds. Otherwise accept the smallest causally
   closed affected design set before retained implementation establishes an
   unresolved, contradictory, or materially non-equivalent relation.

   When `DESIGN_MODULE_METHOD.md` does not apply, design, implementation, and
   tests may co-evolve when upstream truth leaves no unresolved material design
   decision. When such a decision remains, accept the affected design before
   retained implementation establishes it. ADRs are one valid design form.

constraints.statement: First triage/classify intake, select lawful re-entry and identify the consistent downstream span; only then treat work as implementation/repricing/release-bound. For feature change update Goals for changed work wave/overriding concerns, Intent for changed purpose/scope, Product for changed realization/terms/boundaries/end-state. Make requirement invariants explicit as Product decomposition, including lifecycle obligations/named gaps, and classify every new/changed requirement. Establish Design's structural HOW. When DESIGN_MODULE_METHOD applies, co-evolution requires co_evolution_admissible(B); otherwise accept the smallest causally closed affected design set before retained implementation establishes unresolved, contradictory or materially non-equivalent relations. Outside that method, co-evolution requires no unresolved material design decision; otherwise accept affected design before implementation establishes it. ADRs are a valid form. Supply applicable scenarios/evidence; prefer declarative problem/acceptance expression; check support through Goals→Intent→Product→Requirements→Design→implementation. Record major ambiguity and govern by declared risk appetite. Construct realization under selected design/execution binding, reconciling design, behavior and applicable proof before promotion/closure. Observe declared sources against requirements; events/projection/delta apply only when selected, and adequate direct observation remains available.
constraints.uncertainty: The external co_evolution_admissible(B) predicate is not defined in the supplied sections.

conditions: Bootstrapping/repricing or responding to a real-use gap, as specified.

grounding.quote:
5. If the governing requirements and design are sufficient, repair the
   implementation within its grant and recheck the affected obligations. A
   newly discovered need to change governing meaning returns to intake for
   classification and owning-layer re-entry before that change is made.

constraints.statement: For bootstrap/repricing resolve Product Definition, verify installed basis, load bootstrap then Goals/bound epic; write/confirm Intent and Product through goals→intent→product; gather constitutional inputs; derive/bind Requirements at what locations, as individuals or grouped families preserving clarity/ownership. Establish sole live requirement authority before downstream work is treated as governed; prefer declarative structure and record major ambiguity before realization. Only after the surface exists should downstream work count as grounded. For a use-case gap enter intake first and retain unresolved classification until supported; then make Scenario the first substantive gap artifact; analyze evidence for supported cause or distinguishing observation, never infer cause from failure alone. Constitutional change follows selected owning re-entry and downstream reconciliation; Goals/Intent repricing requires their respective conditions, while stable-direction requirement gaps re-enter Requirements. With sufficient requirements/design, repair only within grant and recheck; discovered governing-meaning change returns to intake before change. Bug reports, features, failed tests, release blockers and operator observations all obey this intake-first rule.

exceptions: Superseded by identifies a successor when Status is superseded.
Retained special case records intentionally retained earlier behavior.

grounding.quote:
| `Status:` | `active`, `superseded`, or `retired` |
| `Implements:` | REQ-* IDs this ADR makes true |
| `Derives from:` | INT-* or strategy document that motivated the decision |
| `Supersedes:` | Prior ADR or doctrine this replaces |
| `Superseded by:` | Successor ADR when this ADR is `Status: superseded` |
| `Retained special case:` | When earlier behavior is intentionally retained as a special case of the current surface |

constraints.statement: Each ADR shall explicitly include Status (active/superseded/retired), Implements (REQ-* made true), Derives from (INT-* or motivating strategy), Supersedes (prior ADR/doctrine), Superseded by (successor when superseded), and Retained special case (intentional earlier behavior). Organize ADRs by decision boundary making ACs true, not requirement file. If a requirement names an operational mechanism, its ADR must also name it. Expansion of event taxonomy requires immediate repricing of the EC ADR so event semantics do not become a second constitution.
constraints.uncertainty: EC ADR is not identified or defined in the supplied source; empty/non-applicable field syntax is unspecified.

conditions: The optional profile is selected through its owning adoption relation.
exceptions: Other admitted configurations may use one sufficient frame, peers or adaptive allocation.

grounding.quote:
The three available frames are overlapping evaluation contexts, not a hierarchy
or actor topology. The Worker supplies the candidate subject but never activates the
Reviewer. The Reviewer evaluates but does not implement. The Executive applies
only decision authority already granted by Product, Goals, requirements,
accepted design, ticket, identity, or release law. The Worker carries only the
construction or transformation authority in its admitted intake. No frame gains
admission, publication, mutation, or other operation authority from its label.

constraints.statement: Use existing project authority, complete STDO/Frame Method basis, exact Product or chain outcome/workspace and known evaluation inventory/dependencies/residuals to select sufficient direct Worker activation or materially required coordination. Coordinated work locks outcome/basis and finite ready frontier, obtains applicable Worker/specialist/required Reviewer evaluations, consumes closed results/technical triage/declared conjunction, applies existing bounded decisions, records lawful next action and updates basis/coverage/residuals/frontier before repeating or stopping. Finite context/attention/dependencies/capabilities/assurance motivate bounded allocation, not a unique hierarchy or exhaustive roles. Worker never activates Reviewer; Reviewer never implements; labels/configuration grant no operation authority. The twelve generic families and four testing families are available evaluation contexts, not mandatory actors/stages/components/files/runtime types. Select only material families and retain explicit residuals for uncovered material ones. User-outcome, runnable-path, composition-boundary and module-law claims map respectively to UAT, E2E, integration and unit evidence; results combine only through declared relations. Broader evidence cannot make module law true; any number of narrower green results cannot establish unevaluated composition/user outcomes. Adoption or another configuration requires existing affected-decision authority; carrying it in local axioms creates no owner.

grounding.quote:
Inclusion in an exact released standards cut or another admitted method basis
makes this profile available; it does not adopt it. Adoption requires a
separately accepted Product-owned Project Reference-Frame Basis. Mutable
authoring source, installed file presence, prompts, summaries, and commentary
neither select nor adopt it.

constraints.statement: Pure frame principles belong to REFERENCE_FRAME_METHOD; this profile owns optional mappings; SPEC_METHOD collective-reference-frame-basis owns Product binding and each Product owns its concrete basis. FOUNDATIONS owns shared result/conjunction/current-state/context; Frame Method owns declaration/activation/refinement/translation/coverage/revision; DESIGN_MODULE_METHOD UP-017..019 and SPEC UP-020 supply execution intake, with UP-020 owning construction/self-review/assessment/disposition/checkpoint/continuation. Foundations independence and TICKET UP-007 own independence, required boundaries, exact trace and promotion; SPEC UP-022 owns assurance subjects/populations/freeze. Design Module owns module-derived unit proof and UP-023 foundation comparison without authority transfer. Spec testing rules plus current Product/requirements/accepted design/release select claims, user paths, modes, populations and acceptance. Existing domain/effect/interface/dependency/assurance/identity/release owners retain specialist predicates. Goals/Product/requirements/admitted work select outcomes; accepted design owns structure; identity/project authority binds Executive envelope; Product/release retain reserved acceptance. Instance premises are adopted configuration, selected boundary and actual grants; Executive additionally needs material work/assurance not coverable directly, not finite capacity alone. Every profile requirement applies an owning relation or conditions adoption. Contradiction of an owner is defective application requiring revision, never amendment. Availability from packaging does not adopt/select the profile: separately accepted Product-owned basis is required; source/files/prompts/summaries/commentary cannot substitute.
constraints.uncertainty: Most named owner contracts are outside the supplied sections.

exceptions: A sufficient local outcome with no required independent assessment or reserved acceptance may finish as Writer and record satisfaction in the existing carrier.

grounding.quote:
A sufficient local outcome with no required independent
assessment or reserved acceptance may finish as Writer and record its satisfied
conditions there. It gains no review, ticket, diagram recreation or owner
ceremony solely from using this profile. Any required assessment or owner
decision remains required; newly discovered insufficiency withholds the
dependent effect and returns the affected question to its existing owner.

constraints.statement: A capable context with sufficient work authority, intake and operation grant may activate directly as Worker without an Executive appointment. Coordinate only when material context, authority, capability or required independence cannot be covered directly; role names or available actors create no obligation. Assess actual operations/dependencies/capability/assurance and independence of sources/authorship/evidence. Direct work binds exact intake, operation territory, obligations, evidence, stops and consumer, using the smallest existing TICKET carrier and distinguishing admission from drafting. Required assessments/owner decisions persist; newly discovered insufficiency withholds dependent effect and returns to owner. Executive transition/handoff clauses apply only to coordinated work; direct closed results go to declared work authority/carrier with the same algebra and operation/decision separation. Both routes apply Frame Method applicability/required results and valid C/J/O reuse through their owners, changing neither adopted basis nor missing authority.
constraints.uncertainty: The cited C/J/O and owner-specific reuse contracts are not expanded here.

exceptions: Reviewer duties apply where independent assessment is required and Reviewer is activated.
Executive prioritization/adjudication applies where coordination is required.

grounding.quote:
Repeated resets, extended repair loops, moving review subjects, proof masking,
and duplicate authority are generic signals that a frame declaration,
activation, capability match, basis, or authority relation may be defective.
They justify reevaluation; they do not identify one universal architecture or
grant precedent semantic authority.

constraints.statement: Practice/failure evidence may inform frame selection, qualification and revision but acquires no STDO authority and imports no consumer architecture/names/actors/topology/runtime/artifacts/stages. One bounded authority selects work and finite evaluation frames. Worker constructs one exact candidate, self-reviews, reports and stops. Required independent Reviewer is separately activated, acquires sufficient exact live authority/subject/evidence, retains valid computed facts while judging independently, and returns evidence-bound severity/implications without implementing. Coordinating Executive prioritizes/adjudicates only within existing grant. Failure to perceive a known violation evidences a missing, misactivated, oversized or capability-incompatible frame. Repeated resets, repair loops, moving subjects, proof masking and duplicate authority justify reevaluation of potentially defective frame/activation/capability/basis/authority, not a universal architecture. Visible implementations, dependencies, builders or downstream Products do not thereby become the authored Product.

conditions: The coordinated Executive branch is selected.
exceptions: Mutation is possible only through a separately activated Worker/Writer relation with exact grant, subject and territory, with a same-actor transition recorded before the effect; the actor then is not acting as Executive.

grounding.quote:
An actor occupying Executive must not modify candidate, Product or worktree
bytes or perform an implementation effect. Filesystem or tool access and an
edit being small, test-only, reversible or apparently obvious supply no
exception. Mutation requires a separately activated Worker or Writer relation
with the exact operation grant, subject and write territory. A same-actor role
transition is explicit and recorded in the existing work carrier before the
effect; the actor is no longer acting as Executive for that effect. Recording
or delegating after an Executive edit cannot authorize it retroactively.

constraints.statement: Maintain exact outcome/basis, Product-role map, evaluation inventory/dependencies/frontier, actor envelopes, MVP/release mandate, triage policy and residual boundary; select the smallest dependency-ready set sufficient for the next decision within actor limits. Activate capable evaluators, preserve subjects/bases and consume only closed results or declared translations. Prioritize, determine promotion-boundary effect, apply existing disposition and issue only already-authorized action. The role grants no meaning, implementation, mutation, acceptance, publication or operation authority; material effects stay with exact grant holders. Executive must not mutate candidate/Product/worktree bytes or perform implementation effects. Access, smallness, test-only status, reversibility or apparent obviousness provide no exception; after-the-fact recording/delegation cannot authorize an edit.

conditions: The Executive attention cycle is active.
exceptions: Parallel activations are permitted when their supported dependencies, grants and evidence allow them.

grounding.quote:
These conditions govern ending the attention cycle, not satisfaction of the
Product outcome. A stop uses the [core stop rule](FOUNDATIONS.md#result-algebra)
on the exact interrupted predicate and cause, retaining open obligations,
actual performance and effects. Closed evaluations can include falsifications;
ending the loop cannot promote those results or residuals to satisfaction.

constraints.statement: Initialize U0 from every applicable material evaluation not closed on the current basis and its dependencies, never merely visible returns. While open, select a finite actor-fitting dependency-ready M; activate against exact outcome/basis; keep assurance-independent evaluations free of unclosed peer results; await relevant input when no authorized decision is ready; record every closed result, triage, residual and invalidator; apply only declared conjunction/translation; prioritize/boundary-decide under mandate; reassess affected reliance when subject/basis changes; update U from coverage/dependencies/conflicts/new materiality. End only when all mandatory evaluations are closed, authority explicitly retains every remaining residual consistently with the claim, or applicable stop returns all remaining obligations open. Ending is not satisfaction: retain exact interrupted predicate/cause, actual performance/effects and falsifications. No scheduler/runtime is required. Recursion follows declared dependencies/bounded refinements, not undifferentiated frame copies. If a decision does not fit, refine, acquire another bounded evaluation or stop; never drop material dependencies. Retain source routes/blockers/uncertainty/invalidators in closed returns and preserve frontier through recovery/context loss. Missing results, unknown applicability and uncertain effects stay open even during independent progress. Reviewer severity, Executive priority, boundary effect, disposition and action remain separate ledger entries. Every return requires explicit D relation to Executive/conjunction/another frame; child completion, lateral handoff, model/tool output or shared actor grants no activation/continuation. Consumers receive closed results/source routes, not hidden reasoning.
constraints.uncertainty: Core stop, currentness, recovery and D-relation details remain externally owned.

conditions: Executive is active.
exceptions: Unavailable/unreliable notification or actual supervision duties permit bounded fallback observation with declared purpose, cadence/checkpoint, evidence target and stop/escalation condition.

grounding.quote:
When notification is unavailable or unreliable, or an actual supervision
obligation requires observation, use bounded fallback observation with a
declared purpose, cadence or checkpoint, evidence target, and stop or escalation
condition. Silence proves neither progress nor failure. Investigate a genuine
blocker or material risk and intervene when required, within existing grants;
unknown status alone does not establish a stalled Worker.

constraints.statement: Default re-entry events are decision-relevant closed result, material exception/changed basis, owner request or declared deadline/checkpoint. While Workers execute and no authorized decision is ready, wait; do not repeatedly inspect unfinished work, replay unchanged judgments or request status without decision need. Retain frontier/return conditions/valid evidence and judgments; refresh materially changed support and revalidate locks before activation/disposition. Waiting waives no verification, evidence, independence, closed-result or authority/closure duty. Silence proves neither progress nor failure; unknown status is not a stalled Worker. Investigate genuine blockers/risks and intervene as required within grants. Repeated no-progress observations/returns without new decision evidence require bounded reassessment of frame/grant/dependency/evidence gap and an authorized decision, not continued polling or identical repair on unchanged basis. Reduced churn does not reduce assurance/capability or introduce a universal cost/budget/accounting gate.

conditions: Before activation and disposition.

grounding.quote:
- **coverage-and-return lock** — every material evaluation and interaction is
  closed or explicit residual, and every consumed result followed its declared
  return relation.

constraints.statement: Apply contract application through five locks: outcome—Goal, Product outcome, boundary, lawful re-entry class, MVP/release mandate and triage policy unchanged; basis—subject, authority, dependencies, configuration, topology, evidence, time and candidate exact/current; Product-role—Source Project, Definition, Release Cut, Product, Install, Artifact and dependent Product distinct, Development Product bound to exact Install; authority—semantic/evaluation/operation/decision/acceptance/publication owners and grants unchanged; coverage/return—every material evaluation/interaction closed or explicit residual and every consumed result follows declared return. Changed Product meaning requires owning re-entry. Activation pressure preserves RF-012 admission/work distinction; consumption uses exact predicate/core mapping. Enlarging Executive supplies neither grant nor support.
constraints.uncertainty: RF-012 and contract-application details are not supplied.

grounding.quote:
Exact basis does not make a Source Project immutable. A Worker may
cumulatively mutate the exact Source Project and write territory named by its
operation grant. A Reviewer evaluates an exact candidate checkpoint produced
from that workspace. Repair advances the workspace, creates a new candidate,
and invalidates affected results. A released Product, Release Cut, or exact
Install remains immutable under its own lifecycle law; it does not impose
immutability on the Source Project constructing a successor.

constraints.statement: An installed Product may build its successor or another Product while remaining distinct from mutable source and authored Product. Nesting, shared code/actors, imports, reachability, matching labels or equal output create no identity, composition edge or authority transfer. Exact basis does not freeze Source Project: Worker may cumulatively mutate only its granted exact subject/territory. Reviewer evaluates the resulting exact checkpoint. Repair advances workspace, creates a new candidate and invalidates affected results. Released Product/Cut/exact Install remain immutable under their own lifecycle law without making successor source immutable.

grounding.quote:
Evidence that it satisfies that decision contract maps to
`satisfied`; an established mandate, grant or hard-stop violation maps to
`falsified`; an undecided mandate/application maps to `indeterminate`; missing
evaluation scope/capability maps to `out_of_frame`; an unusable decision basis
maps to `invalid_basis`. Missing causes use the core missing-reason rule. A
lawful `blocks` decision can satisfy this predicate while the candidate claim
is falsified; neither label determines the other result.

constraints.statement: Evidence of failure grants no response authority. Product-owned basis binds severity/priority scales, current-boundary cutoff and non-waivable stops; no universal numeric scale applies. Reviewer records only supported triage, retaining missing causal/repair evidence and indeterminate/out_of_frame pressure where it can change evaluation; it invents no precision and sends no lateral work. Severity, priority, Frame Method result and boundary effect remain distinct and none alone makes a finding release-blocking. Executive selects blocks/narrowing/residual then exactly one existing UP-020 disposition. Lower priority cannot waive a hard stop or falsified mandatory claim; severe out-of-claim observations alone cannot create another review round. Boundary-decision evaluation tests whether this exact finding/boundary decision obeyed current mandate and bound authority: supported compliance→satisfied; established mandate/grant/hard-stop violation→falsified; undecided mandate/application→indeterminate; missing scope/capability→out_of_frame; unusable basis→invalid_basis; missing causes follow core missing-reason law. A lawful blocks decision can be satisfied while candidate claim is falsified.
constraints.uncertainty: The external core missing-reason rule is not supplied.

conditions: After lawful successful activation, for the exact availability predicate and declared bounds.
exceptions: Delivery time is a bound only where the grant requires it.
Unsupported outcome labels yield no verdict; independently admissible evidence on the same bound predicate remains usable.

grounding.quote:
| `candidate_ready` | the bound availability predicate is established, including its declared bounds | `satisfied` |
| `refused` | an established governing prohibition or owner-valid refusal defeats the bound availability predicate after lawful activation | `falsified` |
| `incomplete`, `undecided` | admissible evidence or unfinished bounded work cannot establish the bound availability predicate | `indeterminate` |
| `incomplete`, `postcondition_defeated` | an observed missing delivery, missed declared bound or missing required transition evidence defeats the bound availability predicate | `falsified` |
| `re_entry_requested`, `outside_frame` | a material relation, decision or capability needed to establish the claim lies outside the activated frame | `out_of_frame` |
| `re_entry_requested`, `basis_invalid` | the activated subject or basis cannot support the claim | `invalid_basis` |
| any variant lacking its required cause or its row's evidence condition | retain the raw outcome without inventing deciding support; independently admissible evidence on the same bound predicate remains available | apply the core missing-reason rule; the unsupported label supplies no verdict |

constraints.statement: candidate_ready with established bounded availability maps to satisfied; refused with established governing prohibition/owner-valid post-activation refusal maps to falsified; incomplete/undecided with insufficient evidence or unfinished work maps to indeterminate; incomplete/postcondition_defeated with observed non-delivery, missed bound or missing required transition evidence maps to falsified; re_entry_requested/outside_frame maps to out_of_frame; re_entry_requested/basis_invalid maps to invalid_basis. Required cause/evidence makes mappings exclusive and total over declared lawful-activation cases; absent support preserves raw outcome and invokes missing-reason law, not invented verdict. Generic re-entry alone is insufficient. Later delivery cannot repair an original missed bound; changed bounds create a successor claim. Availability is not fitness/admission/acceptance/publication; equal verdicts do not permit conjunction of different predicates. Keep known non-performance and uncertain effects explicit. Activation-known capability/authority/stale or ambiguous basis/topology mismatch is activation_refusal, never synthetic Worker result. Refusal names reason/authority; incomplete names stop basis; re-entry names owner/material relation. Payload wording, timing or preference cannot select variants. Consumers choose representation; UP-020 owns execution/dispositions. Reference existing classification/evidence/judgment/ruling carriers without reconstructing unchanged C/J/O; check applicability/invalidators and revise only affected results while preserving originals and supported surviving claims.
constraints.uncertainty: Core record and missing-reason/reuse mechanics remain external.

conditions: Executive frame activation is applicable and authorized.
exceptions: Implementation expertise may be delegated to specialist evaluations.
An existing UP-020 disposition is returned where the basis is decidable.

grounding.quote:
The Executive frame does not introduce `authorize` or `no_action` as peer
STDO dispositions. Activation is the `REFERENCE_FRAME_METHOD.md` function;
bounded candidate disposition remains exactly `accept`, `local_repair`,
`re_enter`, or `reject` under `STDO-UP-020`.

constraints.statement: Evaluate outcome/execution authorization, frame/actor capability, exact/current returns and mandate-based priority/boundary effect/disposition/action. Bind complete selected cut, exact Goals/Product/requirements/design/work authority, mandate, workspace/checkpoint, findings/triage/policy and proxy grant; retain affected causal cone, inventory/configuration/envelopes, evidence duties, return results, re-entry owners and continuation boundary. Coordinates distinguish method/project/outcome/mandate/authority/checkpoint/candidate/evidence/finding/policy/actor. Apply RF-001..017, UP-017..020 and applicable identity/ticket/assurance/release law. Evidence includes live authority, frame/specialist results, triage, exact identity, transition evidence and residuals. Capability must cover method/Product/mandate/authority/workspace/triage/actor-selection. Exclude mutation/implementation ownership, silent severity/evidence rewriting, unqualified independent-review claims, others' semantic reconstruction and out-of-grant disposition. Return one Frame Method result, priority/boundary effect and, where decidable, exactly accept/local_repair/re_enter/reject; authorize and no_action are not peer dispositions and projections are not extra results. Material method/authority/outcome/mandate/policy/checkpoint/candidate/evidence/finding/capability/topology change triggers shared applicability reassessment without rewriting historical identity. Unreliable severity/assessment requires capable reevaluation or retained uncertainty, never silent rewriting.
constraints.uncertainty: The cited invariant and currentness contracts are not expanded in the supplied source.

conditions: Sequencing delivery under an existing mandate and operation grants.
exceptions: An early focused user probe remains appropriate when it resolves material outcome uncertainty.

grounding.quote:
During construction, use focused deterministic regression and targeted
judgment probes to resolve material uncertainty. Use unit evidence for
module-owned laws under the testing frames. Schedule substantial,
resource-intensive user-acceptance cycles near release or when a bounded
capability is considered complete enough to qualify. An early focused user
probe remains appropriate when it decides a material outcome uncertainty.

constraints.statement: Establish the smallest runnable thread early; extend/revalidate existing affected threads and expand bounded increments by consequential uncertainty, dependency/interface reach and failure impact. Early E2E/integration evidence constrains incompatible choices, settles exercised interfaces and preserves working composition while focusing unresolved obligations. Passing threads establish only exercised relations/conditions; untested branches, combinations, refusals and recovery keep proof obligations. Revisit settled choices when material counterevidence invalidates basis. Use focused deterministic regression, targeted judgment probes and module-law unit evidence during construction; substantial resource-intensive UAT belongs near release or sufficient bounded-capability completion. Distinct testing claims still govern scenarios, independence and repetitions; reuse requires supported applicability, affected reassessment and mandatory gates.

conditions: A Worker activation has sufficient intake and exact inherited operation grant.
exceptions: Read scope may exceed write territory within declared access to cover the complete causal cone.

grounding.quote:
Read scope follows the complete causal cone and may exceed write territory
within the declared access grant. A narrow mutation grant does not justify
omitting a material producer, consumer or governing owner from inspection.
Return a required repair outside that territory to its owner; understanding the
relation grants no cross-boundary effect.

constraints.statement: Construct the exact authorized outcome through the smallest coherent causal cone, preserving every affected governing relation and disposing competitors. Basis is UP-020 sufficient intake plus applicable accepted UP-017..019 design/execution. Manifold covers entities/lifecycles/transformations/authorities/capabilities/algorithms/I/O/dependencies/seams/failures/proof; exact coordinates bind activation/source checkpoint/workspace/inputs/dependencies/configuration/actor/output/candidate/evidence. Apply all material selected-STDO/project relations; UP-020 owns construction/self-review. Evidence includes live implementation, tests and source, analysis/artifacts, claimed installed/operational behavior, reconstruction/mutations/transition evidence. Capability covers method/domain/implementation/tools/access/finite context. Inherited construction/transformation and self-review grant no admission/publication/independent acceptance/frame-set revision/inferred next action. Exclude upstream semantic change, unauthorized cone expansion, self-acceptance, hidden competitors and advancement after return. Return one Frame Method result plus exactly one candidate_ready/refused/incomplete/re_entry_requested; readiness is not accept and green tests support only exercised production/test semantics. Material intake/basis/checkpoint/dependency/configuration/capability/topology change reassesses affected reliance. Missing, ambiguous or out-of-territory mutation authority refuses the effect. Inspect all material producers/consumers/owners within access; out-of-territory repair returns to owner.

conditions: Reviewer is activated under the owning independence and assessment relations.
exceptions: Technical cause, blast radius, workaround and repair-risk claims are reported only where supported inside activation.

grounding.quote:
Each finding binds a violated property, supported entry or state, governing
operating/threat model and credible causal path. Apply those conditions to
retained guards and acceptance predicates as well as new findings. An excluded
threat alone gives no retention claim; a proposed wider threat model re-enters
its owner. Internal location alone does not establish trust, and hypothetical
hostility alone does not establish applicability. Retain the actual untrusted
input, mutable-state, authority and effect checks required by the supported
model. A suggested repair becomes an obligation only through its proper owner.

constraints.statement: Evaluate exact subject/basis and applicable relations against competing authority, proof masking and unevaluated composition; assess supported finding severity/implications. Bind candidate/claim/STDO/project authority/scope/exclusions/evidence population/Product severity scale/carrier/independence. Inspect material causal producers/consumers, authority seams, competitors, claimed failure/recovery/install/reconstruction, tests/fixtures, historical counterexamples and supported triage. Coordinates preserve candidate/source/authority revision/configuration/dependency/population/scale/install/time/reviewer. Apply RF-001..017, UP-020/007/022 and applicable Product/design/identity/release law; capability covers method/domain/implementation/assurance/triage/tools/access/context/counterexample search/independence. Independently acquire material live authority, implementation/tests/artifacts/history/operations/mutations/replay/reconstruction/reproduced observations; Worker summary cannot substitute. Review access grants no construction/transformation/admission/publication/mutation/decision/disposition/activation. Exclude repair, priority/boundary decisions, next action, assurance-owned semantic reconstruction, unbound evidence flattening and silent scope expansion. Return one Frame Method result plus findings/counterexamples/triage/residuals; material candidate/authority/basis/population/scale/dependency/configuration/scope/independence changes reassess reliance. UP-007 selects required review/trace and UP-022 assurance/freeze; no universal review round/new independence test is created. UP-020 retains assessment/disposition; coordinated Executive acts only through bound mandate/proxy. Record unsupported triage uncertainty. Review test semantics whenever code/fixtures/mutations/environment/interpretation can change proof; green is no substitute. Findings and retained guards need violated property, supported entry/state, operating/threat model and credible causal path.
